name: Rice Leaf Diseases: UCI Visual Disease Classification Benchmark
description: The Rice Leaf Diseases dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository is a targeted agricultural computer vision collection containing 120 digital photographs of diseased rice leaves (Oryza sativa) collected from agricultural fields in Gujarat, India. The dataset provides balanced representation across three devastating plant diseases: Bacterial Leaf Blight (caused by Xanthomonas oryzae), Brown Spot (caused by Bipolaris oryzae), and Leaf Smut (caused by Entyloma oryzae), each represented by exactly 40 JPEG images. Collected to benchmark automated image processing, feature extraction, and shallow/deep machine learning pipelines, the dataset serves as an accessible baseline for agricultural diagnostic systems.
